runs.market_commentary:
Asian markets sold off sharply overnight, with Japan's Nikkei 225 dropping 2.54% to 67,460.73 as rising US Treasury yields and renewed geopolitical risk from Middle East tensions weighed on risk sentiment. The yen strengthened modestly as investors sought safety, while South Korea's KOSPI and Hong Kong's Hang Seng also closed lower. The primary catalyst was Trump's threat to 'bomb' Oman if it interferes with US plans for the Strait of Hormuz, which sent Brent crude surging to $91/barrel and revived stagflation fears globally.

European markets opened softer, with Germany's DAX shedding 0.38% and London's FTSE 100 nearly flat at -0.1%. European bond yields moved higher in sympathy with Treasuries, and energy names were the sole bright spot as oil majors benefited from elevated crude prices. Investor attention is focused on the continued ascent of the US 30-year Treasury yield, which hit 5.327% — its highest level since 2007 — signaling a structural repricing of long-duration risk driven by persistent deficits and AI-related corporate borrowing.

US pre-market futures extended Monday's losses, with S&P 500 futures down 0.52%, Nasdaq-100 futures retreating 1.3%, and Dow futures off 0.2%. The 10-year Treasury yield climbed to 4.739%, compressing equity multiples. Gold rose 0.51% to $4,398/oz as investors sought inflation hedges, while the dollar index edged lower to 99.561. Retail earnings season is imminent with Walmart and Target due later this week. Baidu reports Q2 2026 results this morning, and analyst activity was brisk with upgrades on BBWI, DUOL, TPR, and BAC added to Goldman's conviction list.

ideas.catalyst: WTI crude surged to $84 as President Trump threatened military action against Oman over Strait of Hormuz access, pushing Brent to $91/barrel.
ideas.thesis: Escalating US-Iran tensions will sustain elevated oil prices well above $80/barrel through the near-term, directly boosting ExxonMobil's upstream earnings. As one of the largest integrated majors with ample refining capacity, XOM is structurally positioned to capture both production upside and crack spread benefits.
ideas.key_risk: A diplomatic de-escalation or ceasefire between the US and Iran could rapidly unwind the geopolitical premium embedded in crude prices.

ideas.theme: Bond Bear Market / Rates Higher For Longer
ideas.catalyst: 30-year Treasury yield touched 5.327% today, highest since 2007, driven by heavy government issuance, AI corporate borrowing, and renewed oil-inflation concerns.
ideas.thesis: Structural headwinds — trillion-dollar deficits, AI-driven corporate bond supply, and energy-led inflation — are pushing long-duration yields toward multi-decade highs. TBT offers leveraged exposure to continued long-bond weakness without equity beta.
ideas.key_risk: A sudden risk-off shock or Fed pivot signal could trigger a flight-to-safety rally in long Treasuries, inflicting sharp losses on TBT.

deals.headline: Santander Acquires Webster Bank; Deal Closing August 20
deals.description: Banco Santander's acquisition of Webster Bank is expected to close on August 20, 2026, expanding Santander's US retail banking footprint significantly. The deal reinforces the ongoing consolidation trend among mid-size US regional banks as larger institutions seek deposit growth and branch networks.
deals.sentiment: Bullish for WBS (acquisition premium); neutral-to-positive for SAN

deals.headline: Teledyne Technologies Acquires Varex Imaging for $1.1 Billion
deals.description: Teledyne Technologies acquired Varex Imaging for approximately $1.1 billion, bolstering its medical imaging and industrial X-ray detection capabilities. The deal represents Teledyne's continued strategy of acquiring niche defense and medical technology platforms.
deals.sentiment: Bullish for VREX (buyout premium); slightly dilutive near-term for TDY

deals.headline: OpenAI Acquires Presentation Startup NextSlide
deals.description: OpenAI acquired NextSlide, an AI-powered presentation and productivity startup, as part of its ongoing strategy to build out enterprise productivity tools beyond its core language models. The acquisition signals OpenAI's intent to compete directly with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace in the generative AI productivity layer.
deals.sentiment: Bearish for MSFT/GOOGL (increased AI productivity competition); neutral overall

deals.headline: Nielsen Buys DoubleVerify for $2.15 Billion
deals.description: Nielsen announced the acquisition of digital advertising measurement firm DoubleVerify for $2.15 billion, creating a comprehensive cross-media measurement powerhouse. The deal allows Nielsen to offer advertisers unified measurement across linear TV, streaming, and digital channels.
deals.sentiment: Bullish for DV (acquisition premium); neutral for NLSN pending execution

deals.headline: Tactical Resources Begins Nasdaq Trading After SPAC Combination with Plum Acquisition Corp. III
deals.description: Tactical Resources Corp., a Canadian rare earth exploration company focused on building a US critical minerals supply chain, began trading on Nasdaq on August 18 after completing its business combination with Plum Acquisition Corp. III. The listing reflects sustained investor appetite for domestic rare earth plays amid US-China supply chain tensions.
deals.sentiment: Bullish for rare earth and critical minerals theme
